DLC2323:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Yesterday's enemies are today's friends... and tomorrow's comrades... The end of a battle is also the moment new friendships are born.」

DLC2323:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The tale I am about to tell takes place after $c succeeded in reaching an understanding with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

DLC2323:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As Earth united for a new battle, another battle was ending on $$火星$$, and a new era was about to begin.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:6.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「I am glad to see you all looking well, too.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:7.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Commander, you've come to bid farewell to this $$火星$$ base...」

DLC2323:3:t_2:9.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「As you have already been informed, the $$火星$$ settlement project is temporarily suspended. All settlers have been ordered to return to Earth.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:10.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Evacuating everyone in the $$地球圏$$ to $$蒼の地球$$ in preparation for $$サイデリアル$$'s next invasion...」

DLC2323:3:t_2:11.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「That is the Earth Defense Plan, then.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:12.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The $$連邦政府$$ has decided to bring the civilians together and concentrate its defensive forces in one place at the same time.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It might be a little cramped, but please bear with it.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:14.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's only until we take care of $$バアル$$ and $$サイデリアル$$ out in the galaxy. Shouldn't take too long.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:15.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Please don't worry. We understand the government's decision.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:18.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We've poured our hearts and souls into developing this land, hoping to make it our second home.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:19.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「And now we must abandon our home once again...」

DLC2323:3:t_2:20.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Raise your heads, $$アークセイバー$$s.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:21.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「As long as we live, $$インサラウム$$ lives on... Did we not swear that when we learned our late prince's true intentions?」

DLC2323:3:t_2:23.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「That's right... We chose to live on, even in shame, all for His Highness and $$インサラウム$$...」

DLC2323:3:t_2:24.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Whatever we lose, so long as it is not life itself, we can regain it... We decided that day to live with those words in our hearts.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:25.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Your minds are made up, then?」

DLC2323:3:t_2:27.en:
$$トライア$$
「Then get ready to depart. And while you're at it, I'll need that thing I asked you for.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:28.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「The operating data from the $$火星$$ $$ＺＯＮＥ$$. It's ready for you.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:29.en:
$$トライア$$
「Thanks. The Earth Defense Plan won't be complete until I bring it back.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:32.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So the commander's feeling the same way as her people...」

DLC2323:3:t_2:33.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「I spoke nobly, but this land was a new home to me too. To lose it...」

DLC2323:3:t_2:34.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then let's get out to the galaxy and settle this thing fast.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:38.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Something like that's cheap and easy. Hell, you can have it for free.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:39.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Step away from the commander, $$クロウ・ブルースト$$!」

DLC2323:3:t_2:40.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「As long as we're here, we won't allow you to take liberties with her!」

DLC2323:3:t_2:41.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I was just looking out for a comrade...」

DLC2323:3:t_2:42.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「A comrade!? A comrade, you say!?」

DLC2323:3:t_2:43.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Have you no intention of accepting the commander's feelings!?」

DLC2323:3:t_2:44.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What the hell do you people want from me!?」

DLC2323:3:t_2:45.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Oh, honestly... All of you...」

DLC2323:3:t_2:47.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Unidentified machines confirmed in the vicinity of the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$!」

DLC2323:3:t_2:48.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Judging by the situation, they don't seem to be heading toward us, but...」

DLC2323:3:t_2:49.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Still, we can't just ignore them. We'll go take a look.」

DLC2323:3:t_2:50.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Fortify the defenses in case of an emergency.」

DLC2323:3:t_3:4.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「...In the end, every Burglar was destroyed...」

DLC2323:3:t_3:5.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「We... no longer have the strength to fight...」

DLC2323:3:t_3:6.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Ha, haha... F-O-R R-E-A-L... We're out of business...?」

DLC2323:3:t_3:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That brings things to a close for me too.」

DLC2323:3:t_3:8.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「$$クロウ・ブルースト$$! You...!」

DLC2323:3:t_3:9.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Because of you, $$ファイヤバグ$$ is...!」

DLC2323:3:t_3:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$ファイヤバグ$$, that rotten band of the worst scum imaginable, is dead...」

DLC2323:3:t_3:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「All that's here now is a bunch of pitiful unemployed people.」

DLC2323:3:t_3:12.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「You! You put us in the same position as you...!」

DLC2323:3:t_3:13.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「You good-for-nothing! You wanted to drag us down that far!?」

DLC2323:3:t_3:14.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「We heard you were neck-deep in debt, but who knew it had twisted your personality this badly!?」

DLC2323:3:t_3:15.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「No, no, no, no! I don't want to end up on the streets like little $$クロウ$$!!」

DLC2323:3:t_3:16.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「If you have nowhere to go, come with us.」

DLC2323:3:t_3:19.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「That is in the past, isn't it?」

DLC2323:3:t_3:20.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We will go to $$蒼の地球$$ and take part in the Earth Defense Plan. You will help us with it too.」

DLC2323:3:t_3:21.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「$$ファイヤバグ$$, defending Earth!?」

DLC2323:3:t_3:22.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No, you've got it wrong... You're not $$ファイヤバグ$$. You're just unemployed.」

DLC2323:3:t_3:23.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If you don't want to be called freeloaders, you'd better work for Earth.」

DLC2323:3:t_3:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「By the way, I know a good moneylender. If you want to live on debt, I can introduce you.」

DLC2323:3:t_3:27.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Living on like this, with no prospects at all...」

DLC2323:3:t_3:28.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Not me! I don't want a life drowning in debt like little $$クロウ$$'s!」

DLC2323:3:t_3:30.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Our pride won't let us sink as low as $$クロウ・ブルースト$$!」

review.context: Marguerite evacuates the Mars settlers for the Earth Defense Plan. After Firebug loses its machines, the Arksabers offer its former members useful work, while everyone makes Crowe the butt of the joke.
decisions: Crowe Bluest uses the canonical full-name token.
The settlers object both to imagined impropriety and to Crowe not returning Marguerite feelings; retained their comic contradiction.
Firebug spelled-out slang is adapted as F-O-R R-E-A-L.
